Ranveer comes to Mr. Gupta's house in the guise of a housemaid. He introduces himself as Chhanno and requests Mr. Gupta to hire him for household chores. Mrs. Gupta fires Lakshmi from work. Pooja meets Lakshmi and employ her as housemaid.
